purpose: Replace open-ended pure-price entry discovery with an evidence-anchored research architecture, while first proving that historical positive E events can be reconstructed causally and cheaply enough to justify any larger research effort.

architecture_decision.evidence_anchor_role: A newly qualifying economically material AI-Core filing/event defines when a security becomes research-relevant. This is a candidate-time anchor only until outcome value is separately validated.
architecture_decision.T_layer_role: State, ranking, context and later incremental overlays only. T features do not create E eligibility.
architecture_decision.X_layer_role: Tradability, liquidity, risk and execution constraints only.
architecture_decision.U_layer_role: Official PIT A-share membership authority, unchanged.
architecture_decision.setup_admission_compatibility: PASS. V2.8.4 admission treats strategy semantics as opaque and only requires a causal outcome-free PASS strategy receipt matched to valid U/E provenance for the same security and date.

prospective_observation_ledger.conclusion: Operationally valid but far too small for any alpha or return inference.

effective_event_ledger.conclusion: Confirms effective-date machinery but is not a research sample.

bounded_real_diagnostic.conclusion: Pipeline compatibility is proven; one bounded week is insufficient to estimate positive-event reconstruction density.

temporal_authority.prospective: Retain V2.8.4 rule: first joint A-share trading date strictly after authoritative repository observation date; no same-day activation and no backfill.
temporal_authority.retrospective_reconstruction: Historical pilot is diagnostic only. A reconstructed filing may receive a RETROSPECTIVE_CAUSAL_EFFECTIVE_DATE equal to the first joint A-share trading date strictly after the official filing disclosure date/path date. If official metadata and official path date conflict or temporal provenance is ambiguous, that candidate is blocked.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Determine whether evidence-anchored candidate timing is practically researchable without paying the cost of a multi-year full-market filing backfill first.
hard_constraints: Official issuer filings only for E evidence.
Frozen V2.8.4 eligibility/classification semantics; no rule changes from return outcomes.
Causal historical timestamp treatment and no same-day use.
No price or return data may be read during the reconstruction-feasibility pilot.
soft_assumptions_deleted: Delete the assumption that all 2023-2024 candidate PDFs must be downloaded before feasibility is known.
Delete the assumption that prospective accumulation must continue for months before architecture feasibility can be tested.
Delete the assumption that candidate title/keyword hits are sufficient evidence.

preferred_order.Delete: Do not run a full historical backfill.
preferred_order.Avoid: Use title triage before PDF materialization and block temporal ambiguity.
preferred_order.Absorb: Reuse the existing 18-term collector, official PDF materializer, page text extractor, classifier, issuer identity logic and joint calendar.
preferred_order.Substitute: Estimate reconstruction yield from a deterministic quarter-spread sample instead of exhaustive history.
preferred_order.Precompute_Reuse: Content-addressed PDF/object hashes and announcement IDs prevent duplicate work.
preferred_order.Optimize: Only if bounded reconstruction proves positive-event density and provenance quality.

bounded_historical_reconstruction_pilot.objective: Measure reconstruction feasibility, positive-event yield, temporal provenance quality and official-document cost. It does not test returns or investment alpha.
bounded_historical_reconstruction_pilot.window_rule: For each calendar quarter, use the 21st joint A-share trading session in that quarter as anchor A and collect CNInfo candidate hints from calendar date A through A+6 calendar days inclusive.
bounded_historical_reconstruction_pilot.candidate_collector: Reuse scripts/v284_candidate_collector.py with its exact frozen 18-term registry and SSE/SZSE routes.

per_window_selection.security_diversity: At most one selected filing per canonical_security_id in each window.
per_window_selection.deterministic_order: SHA256(announcement_id) ascending after triage; take the first eligible distinct-security rows until six are selected.

bounded_historical_reconstruction_pilot.classification: Reuse frozen page-scoped V2.8.4 classifier and aggregation semantics with no rule changes.

pilot_required_outputs: all eight computed anchor dates and seven-calendar-day query windows
candidate counts before and after deduplication per window
triage skip and materializable counts per window
selected announcement IDs and canonical security IDs with deterministic selection hashes
PDF materialization and page-text extraction success/blocker counts
for every historical ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE filing: evidence page, evidence sentence hash, matched AI role, matched commerciality, source object hash and retrospective causal effective date
distinct positive securities and distinct positive quarters

technical_requires_all: All eight deterministic query windows execute or have an explicit source blocker.
At least 90% of selected filings successfully materialize and yield classifier-ready page text.
100% of reconstructed positive events have unambiguous canonical security identity.
100% of reconstructed positive events have non-conflicting official temporal provenance sufficient for the conservative next-trading-date rule.
No classifier, triage or eligibility semantic changes are made after seeing pilot classifications.
positive_event_density_for_expansion: At least 4 distinct canonical securities among those positives.
Positive events span at least 3 distinct calendar quarters.
pilot_feasibility_gate.rationale: This is not an alpha-significance threshold. It is the minimum evidence that the pipeline produces more than isolated one-off positives across time and issuers at a bounded document cost.
pilot_feasibility_gate.if_all_pass: V2_8_11_BOUNDED_E_RECONSTRUCTION_FEASIBLE; authorize a separately frozen historical E-event reconstruction expansion design, still without return inspection.
pilot_feasibility_gate.if_technical_pass_density_fail: V2_8_11_E_EVENT_RECONSTRUCTION_TOO_SPARSE; do not authorize broad backfill; continue prospective E accumulation or reconsider evidence-source architecture without price tuning.
pilot_feasibility_gate.if_technical_fail: V2_8_11_E_RECONSTRUCTION_TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED; fix only provenance/materialization implementation defects, not classification semantics or density thresholds.

explicitly_not_authorized: No D+5/D+10 or other return computation in the pilot.
No use of folds0-2 price histories during the pilot.
No historical E state backfill into the prospective ledger.
No treating historical reconstructed positives as already validated Setup signals.
No keyword expansion, classifier relaxation or hand-picking companies to increase positive yield.
No technical filter overlays in the pilot.
